name: Cedar Lakes Woods & Gardens
coordinateNote: Garden-area centroid from the OpenStreetMap-derived Mapcarta listing, not a surveyed entrance. Use the official street address for driving.
navigationNote: Drive to the official garden address; the pin marks the garden area.
experience: Walk through a former limestone quarry transformed into terraced gardens, waterfalls, ponds and scenic overlooks. The 20-acre garden offers a self-guided walking route, with benches and places to pause above the water. A distinctive dry-land outing in Williston; swimming is prohibited.
duration: About 90 minutes for the marked garden trails, according to the operator.
cost: Adult admission $12 plus 7% sales tax ($12.84). Children 5 and under free; published child and concession prices are linked.
access: 4990 NE 180th Ave, Williston. Published daily hours: 9:30 a.m.–4:45 p.m.; allow about 90 minutes. Holiday hours differ. Self-guided garden tour included; no swimming or fishing.

conditions.summary: Operator hours, admission, garden map and access information checked October 29. Published visitor guidance, not a same-day inspection.

water: Garden ponds and quarry scenery; swimming is prohibited.
mobility: The lower gardens require a steep ramp and uneven terrain. Upper overlooks also have inclines and rocky sections. Accessible restrooms are available; the entire garden is not wheelchair accessible.
